correctness.rationale: All 64 binary length-six words are vertices of a compatibility graph, with an edge iff cyclic pair distance >=5. An independent increasing-order clique search finds exact maximum size eight and 32 labeled size-eight cliques, with four including zero. Independently traced every code's XOR translation to one of four XOR-closed 3-spaces, proving all arbitrary maxima affine. For every maximum code, its 28 word-pairs have 24 pair distances five and four distances six. Rotations/reflections of cyclic coordinates transitively permute the four zero-containing subspaces; with all 64 word translations the prescribed order-768 group acts transitively on all 32, giving stabilizer size24. The independent code uses no linear-space restriction and includes the n=6 census as one case; the source's standalone verify.py separately tests the full graph and claimed symmetry.
correctness.risk: Only n=6, binary alphabet, 8 words and threshold pair distance5; natural symmetry subgroup not asserted to be complete automorphism group.
